description: This file defines the 'PolicyEntryCreated' class, an immutable Java class representing an event emitted after the creation of a 'PolicyEntry' in the system. It includes methods for constructing instances, parsing from JSON, and retrieving event data. The class extends an abstract event class and implements interface methods related to policy events.

classes.name: PolicyEntryCreated
classes.description: An immutable event class indicating that a 'PolicyEntry' has been created. It provides methods to create instances, parse from JSON, and access event data.
